{
  "data": "@startuml sequence-nilai
!theme plain
title Sequence Diagram - Unggah Nilai & Notifikasi Ganda (Arsitektur MVC)

/' ====================================================================
PENJELASAN SIMBOL
1. Actor / Participant: aktor pengguna dan komponen sistem.
2. Arsitektur MVC: View (antarmuka), Controller (pengendali), Model
   (logika bisnis). Data memakai nama entitas langsung (nilai, user,
   notifikasi), bukan istilah umum "database".
3. Life Line, Activation, Message (-> / -->), Recursive.
==================================================================== '/

actor "Wali Kelas" as Wali
participant "Halaman Input Nilai (View)" as View
participant "NilaiController" as Ctrl
participant "NilaiModel (Model)" as Model
participant "nilai" as Nilai
participant "user" as UserEnt
participant "notifikasi" as NotifEnt
participant "NotifikasiService (WS)" as WS
participant "Fonnte (WA)" as Fonnte
actor "Orang Tua" as Ortu

Wali -> View : Isi data nilai siswa
activate View
View -> Ctrl : Kirim data nilai siswa
activate Ctrl
Ctrl -> Model : Validasi & simpan nilai
activate Model
Model -> Nilai : Simpan nilai (transaksi)
activate Nilai
Nilai -> Nilai : Validasi & commit

alt Data tidak valid
  Nilai --> Model : transaksi gagal
  deactivate Nilai
  Model --> Ctrl : validasi gagal
  deactivate Model
  Ctrl --> View : pesan kesalahan
  deactivate Ctrl
  View --> Wali : Tampilkan error
  deactivate View

else Data valid
  Nilai --> Model : Nilai tersimpan
  deactivate Nilai
  Model -> UserEnt : Cari akun orang tua
  activate UserEnt
  UserEnt --> Model : akun orang tua ditemukan
  deactivate UserEnt
  Model -> NotifEnt : Simpan notifikasi
  activate NotifEnt
  NotifEnt --> Model : Tersimpan
  deactivate Model
  Ctrl --> View : nilai & notifikasi tersimpan
  deactivate Ctrl
  View --> Wali : Tampilkan sukses
  deactivate View
end

' Notifikasi dikirim hanya saat data valid (paralel)
par In-app dan WhatsApp
  NotifEnt -> WS : Trigger notifikasi real-time
  activate WS
  WS --> Ortu : Terima notifikasi in-app
  deactivate WS
else
  NotifEnt -> Fonnte : Kirim pesan WhatsApp
  activate Fonnte
  Fonnte --> Ortu : Terima pesan WhatsApp
  deactivate Fonnte
end

/*
====================================================================
LEGEND (keterangan gambar)
====================================================================
| Komponen | Keterangan |
| Actor | Wali Kelas & Orang Tua. |
| View | Halaman input nilai. |
| Controller | NilaiController. |
| Model | NilaiModel. |
| nilai / user / notifikasi | Entitas/data (tabel). |
| NotifikasiService (WS) | Pengirim notifikasi real-time. |
| Fonnte (WA) | Gateway WhatsApp. |
| Life Line / Activation / Message | Simbol standar UML. |
====================================================================
*/


@enduml
",
